subject: DPA execution & UK Addendum — signing path, TIA evidence, and logging cadence
messages:
From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@deltahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA execution and UK Addendum: signature window & technical evidence

Hi Hannah / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the helpful conversation last week. We reviewed Redwood's DPA redline and have two parallel asks to keep the procurement and security tracks moving:

1) Execution window: DeltaHealth needs the DPA + UK Addendum signed by 2025-06-26 to align with our vendor onboarding sprint. Please share the DocuSign path or a signing ETA.

2) Technical evidence: our security and privacy teams require a bundled submission that covers the scoped TIA (DTIA) sampling plan, KMS attestation, log retention and granularity, and an up-to-date subprocessor registry for the UK Addendum. We've attached an evidence request spreadsheet (Delta_Evidence_Request.xlsx) and our redlines on the DPA (Delta_DPA_redline_v3.pdf).

Key clarifying questions we need answered up-front:
- Can Redwood commit to 13 months of audit log retention for request traces tied to DeltaHealth tenant IDs?
- Will Redwood provide an itemized TIA scope (which endpoints/systems are in-scope) and a findable bundle of artifacts (config exports, key rotation policy excerpts, SOC2 map)?
- For the UK Addendum, we need the current subprocessor list with country residency flags and whether onshore caching will ever be used.

Procurement will also need billing/contact information and the DocuSign link to route the agreement to finance.

Can your team confirm a plan by end of day Monday (2025-06-16)? If easier we can jump on a quick align call — available Tues/Wed morning UK time.

Best,
Maria Garcia
Senior Privacy Counsel
DeltaHealth

Attachments: Delta_DPA_redline_v3.pdf (pdf), Delta_Evidence_Request.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@deltahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA execution and UK Addendum: signature window & technical evidence

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear asks and the redline. Quoting the key items below for visibility: 

> Can Redwood commit to 13 months of audit log retention for request traces tied to DeltaHealth tenant IDs?
> Will Redwood provide an itemized TIA scope and a bundle of artifacts?
> For the UK Addendum, provide current subprocessor list with residency flags and onshore caching notes.

We can support the requested path; proposed plan and owners:

- DocuSign/signing path: Laura will prepare a DocuSign envelope that includes the DPA + UK Addendum with your redlines accepted where feasible and clear callouts where Legal needs to review. Expect DocuSign link by EOD Monday (2025-06-16). (Owner: Laura Bennett)

- Evidence bundle / TIA scope: We'll produce a compact "TIA-Scoped Evidence Package" (redwood_tia_scope_summary.pdf) that maps artifacts to your Delta_Evidence_Request spreadsheet. This will include: key rotation excerpts, SOC2 control mappings, and a sampled configuration export for the inference runtime components you flagged. (Owner: Hannah Schmitt + Jordan Blake)

- Subprocessors and residency: Kimberly will export the current subprocessor CSV with country flags and a short note on whether any onshore caching fallback is enabled for EU/UK tenant traffic. We'll call out any passive caching (read-only prefix caching) vs. persistent residency caches. (Owner: Kimberly Park)

- Logging retention: Jordan — can you confirm token-level request-trace retention windows and whether we can guarantee 13 months? If there are any data lifecycle or infra constraints (e.g., warm/cold storage tiers), flag them explicitly. (Owner: Jordan Blake)

Proposed timeline:
- Mon 2025-06-16 EOD: DocuSign link + initial subprocessor CSV and TIA scope summary (partial artifacts).
- Tue 2025-06-17: evidence bundle uploaded to a secure Drive link; align call if needed.
- Fri 2025-06-26: target contract signature for DPA + UK Addendum.

Proposed align call: Tue 2025-06-17 10:00 PT / 18:00 BST — does that work for you? If earlier works, we can accommodate.

I attached a short scope summary and I'll follow up with the Drive link when the bundle is staged.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Trust Programs, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Attachments: redwood_tia_scope_summary.pdf (pdf), subprocessors_20250615.csv (csv)

From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@deltahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement@deltahealth.com
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 12:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA execution and UK Addendum: signature window & technical evidence

Hannah — appreciate the owners and timeline. A couple quick clarifications before we lock the call: 

1) Logging retention: 13 months is a must for our security team. If you have a tiered retention model that archives older logs to cold storage with slower retrieval, that's acceptable provided the data is searchable by tenant ID and can be produced in <72 hours for incident response. Please confirm in writing.

2) Onshore caching fallback: our privacy team wants a clear statement of whether payloads (even ephemeral request prefixes) may persist on UK-hosted caches for customer requests. If any component could write tenant-correlated data outside the EU/UK boundary, we need that documented and a fall-back policy.

3) Procurement request: please include the billing contact for Redwood and a sample invoice template in the Drive bundle; procurement@deltahealth.com needs PO routing details to attach to DocuSign.

If you can confirm 1–3 pre-call, we can keep the align call short and focused on any redline exceptions.

Thanks,
Maria

Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal — Re: DPA execution & UK Addendum (action items and owners)

Team — summary and clear asks from Maria: 13-month searchable retention by tenant ID (produced <72h), explicit note on any onshore caching/persistence, DocuSign + procurement artifacts. Timeline target: DocuSign by EOD Mon, evidence staged Tue.

Action items (owners & suggested content):
- Kimberly: export subprocessors_20250615.csv with columns [processor, role, country, UK-residency-flag, cache_policy], add a short note for each processor if they handle prefix caching. Deliverable: CSV + 2-line README. (Due: Mon EOD)

- Jordan: confirm retention SLA — can we guarantee 13 months searchable? If yes, list retrieval SLA (<72h) and whether retrieval hits cold storage (and any retrieval costs). If no, propose mitigation language we can share. Also confirm whether request traces include tenant ID at the indexable level. (Due: Mon EOD)

- Laura: prepare DocuSign envelope that wraps the DPA + UK Addendum and includes the procurement metadata fields (billing contact, Redwood EIN, sample invoice). Also attach the evidence Drive link once available. (Due: Mon EOD)

- Hannah: assemble the TIA-Scoped Evidence Package and map artifacts to Delta_Evidence_Request.xlsx. I'll draft the short cover note that explains the sampling approach and which artifacts are full vs sampled. (Due: Tue morning)

Two quick asks:
1) Kimberly/Jordan — flag any subprocessor that cannot be publicly disclosed (we'll mask in the CSV and provide a private list under NDA if needed).
2) Laura — make sure DocuSign has a field for PO number and procurement contact.

Let's treat this as high priority — procurement may gate the onboarding sprint. Ping me on Slack if you need to triage.

Thanks — Hannah
